nodes.label: Advanced retrieval
nodes.rationale: Combine semantic and keyword results using BM25 and reciprocal rank fusion, then remove near duplicates.

nodes.label: Demo mode
nodes.rationale: Deterministic templates and source matching let teachers try the complete workflow without a model.

nodes.label: Graph retrieval
nodes.rationale: Expand hybrid anchors through nearby passages and shared terms with a 40-node visit limit and one or two hops.

nodes.label: Qdrant vector index
nodes.rationale: Vectors reference authoritative SQLite chunks and can be rebuilt from saved chunks.

nodes.label: Durable generation
nodes.rationale: A document and idempotency key identify each attempt. Persisted stage supports recovery, and revision checks protect teacher edits during inference.

nodes.label: Student and teacher export projections
nodes.rationale: Explicit copy types separate answer keys, scoring guidance, citations and review notes from student output.

nodes.label: Source-scoped retrieval
nodes.rationale: Filter by document and selected source IDs, then validate returned chunk IDs against the authoritative corpus.
